scope: offline source-repaired full-1400 CMI prescreens; no MC1, admission, portfolio, live, execution, or exchange mutation
selection_rule: Exactly one arm per family, selected by the predeclared target/query SStableMeta rule before any full-1400 CMI result exists. The selected arms must not be changed in response to CMI, Meta, MC1, or portfolio outcomes.

base_explanation_v1.evidence_population: timestamp-local strongest 15% of the frozen Base score
base_explanation_v1.cmi_conditioning: joint deterministic, fold-local, outcome-free Base Explanation V1 strata

objective_trial_grid.selection_rule: run all nine target-neutral LambdaRank trials for each selected family; select SStableMeta on 2025 only, with conditional MI and top-2 substitution as predeclared tie-breakers

next_stage: Run one strict-OOF full-1400 prescreen per frozen arm after every source-repaired expanded-base full-feature month from 2024-12 through 2025-07 has sealed. No MDA stage is requested. Convert each sealed prescreen to an 80-feature contract, then run the hash-bound nine-trial objective grid separately for each family.
